blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: As wearable and digital health systems increasingly generate longitudinal physiological records, communicating these observations in patient-accessible language remains a significant challenge. Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a promising mechanism for translating structured clinical information into readable narratives, but this process may introduce semantic drift, where clinically precise meaning is distorted during simplification. We investigate evidence-grounded health summarization for menstrual health monitoring using a constrained generation framework that combines structured evidence conditioning with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) using a prompt-based constrained generation framework. We evaluate semantic alignment using Natural Language Inference (NLI), atomic factuality metrics, and readability measures. Across three LLMs and 4,500 generated summaries, explicit grounding constraints consistently improve clinical alignment, particularly by improving uncertainty preservation and, once faithfulness is evaluated against retrieved evidence, generally preserving or improving faithfulness, while effects on omission remain model-dependent. We also find that improved clinical alignment comes at the cost of increased reading difficulty and medical terminology. These findings highlight the need to jointly evaluate faithfulness, uncertainty preservation, and readability when developing patient-facing medical LLM systems.
blocks.zh: 由于可穿戴和数字化的保健系统越来越多地产生纵向生理记录,用患者可使用的语言传播这些观测结果仍然是一个重大挑战。 大型语言模型(LLMs)为将结构化的临床信息翻译为可读的叙事提供了一个很有希望的机制,但这一过程可能会引入语义漂移,在简化过程中,临床上准确的含义被扭曲. 我们利用一个限制生成框架,将结构化的证据条件与利用快速生成限制生成框架的检索增强生成(RAG)结合起来,对月经健康监测的循证健康总结进行调查。 我们利用自然语言推论、原子事实度量和可读性度量来评价语义的校正。 在三个法学硕士和4,500个研究摘要中,明确的制约因素不断改善临床一致性,特别是通过改进不确定性的保存,一旦根据收集的证据评估忠诚性,一般保持或提高忠诚性,而对疏漏的影响仍然取决于模式。 我们还发现,由于阅读困难和医学术语增加,临床一致性得到改善。 这些调查结果突出表明,在发展患者的医学LLM系统时,需要共同评价忠诚性、不确定性的保存和可读性。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: The growing integration of wearable and digital health technologies into everyday life has created an expanding stream of longitudinal physiological data (spanning menstrual cycle phases, heart rate variability (HRV), skin temperature, and sleep quality) that is increasingly interpreted by patients themselves rather than by clinicians. Communicating these observations in accessible lay language is therefore a task with direct implications for patient safety and health literacy.
blocks.zh: 可穿戴和数字保健技术日益融入日常生活,从而产生了越来越多的纵向生理数据(月经周期周期、心率可变性、皮肤温度和睡眠质量),这些数据越来越多地由病人自己而不是临床医生来解释。 因此,用无障碍非专业语言传播这些观察结果是一项任务,对病人的安全和卫生知识的普及有直接影响。

blocks.en: Large Language Models (LLMs) present a compelling mechanism for this translation. Recent work demonstrates that adapted LLMs can match or exceed medical expert performance on standard clinical summarization benchmarks Van Veen et al. (2024) , and the field has seen rapid advances in factuality verification, constrained generation, and longitudinal narrative synthesis. Semantic drift, defined as the accumulation of semantic change as medical concepts move from clinical to public discourse, has been shown to be greatest at precisely this transition point Karakkaparambil James et al. (2026) . Our work operationalizes this broader phenomenon in the context of automated summarization, introducing a five-category clinical alignment taxonomy and a constrained generation framework to systematically measure and mitigate misalignment across these dimensions.
blocks.zh: 大语言模型(LLMs)为这种翻译提供了令人信服的机制. 最近的工作表明,经过调整的LLMS在标准临床归纳基准上可以匹配或超过医学专家的绩效 Van Veen 等 (2024年),实地在实际核实,受限生成和纵向叙事综合方面都取得了迅速进展. 语义漂移被定义为语义变化的积累,作为医学概念从临床到公共讨论的转移,在确切的这个过渡点Karakkaparambil James等人(2026年)被证明是最大的. 我们的工作在自动归纳的背景下将这一更广泛的现象付诸实施,引入了五类临床调整分类学和受限制的生成框架,以系统地衡量和减轻这些层面的错配。

blocks.en: Existing approaches to health text simplification assume a semantically equivalent reference document to simplify. Our setting is fundamentally different, generating patient-facing narratives directly from structured physiological observations, where faithfulness must be verified against raw evidence rather than a reference text. This gap is particularly consequential in menstrual health monitoring, where cyclical signals, intrinsic uncertainty, and the documented consequences of urgency miscalibration make evidence-grounded generation especially critical.
blocks.zh: 现有的简化卫生文本的办法假定一个完全等同的参考文件可以简化。 我们所处的环境根本不同,直接从结构化的生理观察中产生与病人相适应的叙事,在这些叙事中,忠诚必须对照原始证据而不是参考文本加以核实。 在月经健康监测中,这种差距尤其严重,周期性信号、内在不确定性和有记录的紧急情况后果使循证生成变得尤为重要。

blocks.en: This paper makes the following contributions: • We formalize the structured-to-narrative summarization task for longitudinal physiological records and introduce an evaluation concept using a taxonomy of five semantic drift conditions: Faithfulness Violation , Epistemic Misalignment , Diagnostic Inference Overreach , Omission Drift , and Urgency Misalignment . • We design and implement a framework for the semi-synthetic generation of medically grounded menstrual health data. • We propose an LLM-based generation pipeline combining explicit evidence-grounding constraints, targeting each alignment category in the taxonomy, with RAG that supports simplification through retrieved lay-term definitions. • We systematically evaluate the clinical alignment of generated patient narratives along the defined taxonomy and derive preliminary insights on favorable configurations of such a setup in menstrual health monitoring. Taken together, this work positions trustworthy simplification as a central and measurable challenge in human-centered digital health.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Clinical Summarization and Lay-Language Simplification
blocks.zh: 2.1 临床总结和语言简化

blocks.en: Clinical summarization includes both expert-to-expert tasks, such as radiology impressions and discharge summaries, and expert-to-patient communication, which requires lay-language simplification grounded in health literacy. Van Veen et al. (2024) show that adapted LLMs can match or exceed human expert performance across multiple clinical summarization tasks, suggesting that output fluency is less of a bottleneck than semantic fidelity. In longitudinal settings, CLIN-SUMM D’souza et al. (2025) demonstrates the value of temporally structured summarization, while Ferrazzi et al. (2026) show that supervised fine-tuning and constrained decoding can allow small domain-specific models to outperform much larger ones. This motivates our use of explicit generation constraints, though we apply them at the prompting level rather than through decoding-time control.
blocks.zh: 临床总结既包括专家对专家的任务,例如放射学印象和出院摘要,也包括专家对病人的交流,这需要基于健康知识的非语言简化。 车 Veen等人(2024年)表明,经过调整的LLMS可以在多个临床归纳任务中与人类专家的性能相匹配或超过,这表明出产流能不如语义忠贞的瓶颈. CLIN-SUMM D ' souza等人的纵向设置。 (2025年)证明了时间结构的总结值,而Ferrazzi等人(2026年)则表明,有监督的微调和受约束的解码可以使小域特有模型的性能超过更大的模型. 这促使我们使用明确的生成限制,尽管我们在迅速的层面上应用这些限制,而不是通过解码时间控制。

blocks.en: For patient-facing communication, simplification is closely tied to health literacy and self-management outcomes Fitzpatrick (2023) . Resources such as README Yao et al. (2024) and multi-stage simplification pipelines like S3 support medical-to-lay translation, but prior work consistently highlights a trade-off between readability and fidelity. Simplification can improve accessibility while omitting or distorting clinically important qualifiers, a pattern consistent with semantic drift in the transition from evidence to narrative Karakkaparambil James et al. (2026) . Recent work addresses this tension through fidelity-readability optimization Verma et al. (2026) , and reproductive health further complicates simplification due to indirect or stigmatized language Hua et al. (2026) . These findings underscore the need for evidence-grounded generation.
blocks.zh: 就病人的沟通而言,简化与卫生知识普及和自我管理成果密切相联(2023年)。 README Yao等资源(2024年)和S3等多相简化管线支持医疗到操翻译,但前期工作始终强调可读性和忠诚之间的取舍. 简化可以改善可获取性,同时省略或扭曲临床上重要的限定词,这种模式与从证据向叙事的Karakkaparambil James等人(2026年)过渡时的语义漂移是一致的. 近期的工作通过对Verma等人(2026年)的忠诚可读性优化来解决这一紧张关系,而生殖健康由于间接或污名化的语言Hua等人(2026年)而使简化更加复杂。 这些调查结果突出表明,需要以证据为依据生成证据。

blocks.en: However, existing benchmarks focus on summarizing or simplifying existing clinical text. They do not address generation directly from structured physiological observations, where faithfulness must be preserved against raw evidence rather than a reference document.
blocks.zh: 然而,现有的基准侧重于总结或简化现有的临床文本。 它们并不直接从结构化的生理观察中处理生成问题,在这些观察中,必须参照原始证据而不是参考文件来保持忠诚。

blocks.en: 2.2 NLI-Based Faithfulness Assessment and Hallucination Verification
blocks.zh: 2.2 基于NLI的宗教信仰评估和幻觉核查

blocks.en: Natural Language Inference (NLI) Bowman et al. (2015) ; Williams et al. (2018) is widely used for factuality assessment in summarization, especially when combined with atomic fact decomposition Min et al. (2023) ; Kamoi et al. (2023) . In medical settings, this is particularly relevant because hallucinations often reflect reasoning failures rather than missing knowledge Pal et al. (2023) . Benchmarks such as Med-HALT and MedHalu show that instruction tuning can even worsen hallucination behavior, motivating verification-based evaluation.
blocks.zh: 自然语言推论(NLI) Bowman等 (2015); Williams等 (2018) 被广泛用于概括性的事实性评估,特别是结合原子事实分解Min等 (2023); Kamoi等 (2023). 在医疗环境中,这一点特别相关,因为幻觉常常反映推理失败,而不是缺少知识Pal等(2023年). Med-HALT和MedHalu等基准显示,指令调谐甚至会使幻觉行为恶化,促使基于核查的评价.

blocks.en: Clinical NLI was established by MedNLI Romanov and Shivade (2018) , but several limitations remain. Clinical NLI datasets contain annotation artifacts that can inflate performance Herlihy and Rudinger (2021) , NLI models degrade under domain shift Jullien et al. (2024) , and textual entailment is not equivalent to factual support Mor-Lan and Levi (2024) . In addition, atomic-level verification depends heavily on the consistency of fact decomposition in clinical text Munnangi et al. (2025) .
blocks.zh: 临床NLI由MedNLI Romanov和Shivade(2018年)建立,但仍有一些限制. 临床NLI数据集包含可以提升性能的注释文物Herlihy和Rudinger (2021),NLI模型在域位移Jullien等(2024)下降解,而文字暗示不等同于事实支持Mor-Lan和Levi (2024). 此外,原子层面的核查在很大程度上取决于临床文本Munnangi等人(2025年)中事实分解的一致性.

blocks.en: The most relevant paradigm is decompose-then-verify. FActScore Min et al. (2023) evaluates generated text at the atomic-claim level against trusted evidence, while AlignScore Zha et al. (2023) learns a broader alignment function across NLI, QA, and IR tasks. Despite known limitations, these claim-level methods are better suited than surface metrics such as ROUGE for detecting the subtle semantic drift central to our setting.
blocks.zh: 最相关的范式是分解——当时的验证. FActScore Min等人(美国) (2023年)对照可信赖的证据评价原子-索赔层生成的文本,而AlignScore Zha等(2023年)则学习了更广泛的NLI,QA,和IR任务之间的对接功能. 尽管存在已知的局限性,但这些主张层面的方法比ROUGE等地表测量标准更适合检测我们环境的核心微妙语义漂移.

blocks.en: Overall, prior work has studied constrained generation, factuality verification, and longitudinal summarization largely in isolation. To our knowledge, no work has combined them for structured-to-narrative, patient-facing summarization of wearable health data. Our paper addresses this gap.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,以前的工作主要孤立地研究了有限的生成、事实核查和纵向总结。 据我们所知,没有一项工作将它们结合起来,对可穿戴的健康数据进行结构化到叙述性、病人化的总结。 我们的文件涉及这一差距。

blocks.en: This work investigates whether evidence-grounded and constrained language generation can improve semantic alignment during the simplification of longitudinal health observations into patient-facing summaries. The framework targets factual consistency, uncertainty calibration, and clinical faithfulness while maintaining accessibility for non-expert users.
blocks.zh: 这项工作调查了在将纵向健康观察简化为病人健康观察摘要期间,基于证据和受限制的语言生成是否能够改善语义上的一致。 该框架针对的是事实一致性、不确定性校准和临床忠实,同时保持非专家用户的无障碍性。

blocks.en: 3.1 Task Definition
blocks.zh: 3.1 任务定义

blocks.en:
Given a structured set of physiological observations derived from longitudinal health monitoring, the task is to generate a patient-oriented natural language summary that remains faithful to the underlying evidence, avoids unsupported medical claims, preserves clinically relevant uncertainty, and is understandable to non-expert users. Formally, let X = { x 1 , x 2 , … , x n } X=\{x_{1},x_{2},\ldots,x_{n}\} denote a structured physiological record
containing observed signals, symptom annotations, and contextual metadata. The objective
is to generate a lay-language summary Y Y such that the generated content remains
semantically aligned with X X while minimizing factual distortion.
The evaluation of this semantic alignment is detailed in Sec. 3.5 .
3.2 Dataset Construction
blocks.zh: 3.2 数据集建设

blocks.en: Due to the limited availability of publicly accessible longitudinal menstrual-health datasets paired with patient-oriented summaries, this study employs a semi-synthetic structured dataset generated via a causal directed acyclic graph (DAG) that encodes known physiological dependencies across the menstrual cycle. The generator produces 500 single-day observations, each drawn from a stochastically determined cycle, following a biologically motivated causal ordering: temporal structure (cycle and luteal-phase length, calibrated to population data Bull et al. (2019) ; Fehring et al. (2006) ) determines phase and cycle day; sleep quality and duration are conditioned on phase, reflecting progesterone-mediated sleep disruption Baker and Driver (2007) ; resting heart rate and HRV trend are jointly conditioned on phase and sleep, capturing both hormonal modulation Tenan et al. (2014) and acute sympathetic override; SpO 2 is sampled independently as a homeostatically regulated signal; and symptoms are generated as downstream consequences of these upstream states rather than independent annotations.
blocks.zh: 由于可公开获取的纵向月经健康数据集与面向病人的摘要对接的有限,本研究采用了通过因果定向环形图(DAG)生成的半合成结构数据集,该数据集将整个月经周期已知的生理依赖性编码. 发电机产生500个单日观测数据,每个观测数据都取自一个有生理动机的因果顺序的分解周期:时间结构(周期和润滑相长,校正为Bull等人(2019年);Fehring等人(2006年))确定相和相日;睡眠质量和持续时间以相相为条件,反映由孕酮调节的睡眠中断贝克和司机(2007年);休息心率和HRV趋势共同以相和相睡眠为条件,捕获了激素调性特南等人(2014年)和急性同情性超标;SPO 2作为自家调节信号独立取样;症状是这些上游状态的下游后果,而不是独立说明。

blocks.en: To simulate real-world data sparsity, each sample is assigned one of five user profiles ( minimal_tracker to advanced_wearable ) that determine which fields are observable, probabilistically available, or systematically absent, producing behaviorally mediated structured missingness. A confidence score, derived from resulting data completeness and phase clarity, provides uncertainty metadata for downstream generation. The full causal record (pre-masking) is retained as ground truth X X , enabling evaluation of whether generated summaries faithfully reflect available evidence without hallucinating masked information.
blocks.zh: 为了模拟现实世界的数据相接性,每个样本被分配到五个用户剖面图(最小的_tracker to advanced_wearable )中的一个,以确定哪些字段是可观测的,有概率的,或者有系统缺失,产生行为调解结构缺失. 从由此产生的数据完整性和相位清晰度中得出的置信分数为下游生成提供了不确定性元数据. 完整的因果记录(假冒前)被保留为地基真理X-X,从而能够评价生成的总结是否忠实地反映现有证据而无需产生幻觉被掩盖的信息.

blocks.en: 3.3 System Overview
blocks.zh: 3.3 系统概况

blocks.en:
Our system takes each patient’s structured menstrual-health record (fields such as cycle timing, symptoms, trends, and related clinical context) and generates patient-facing summaries under three generation regimes: Base , Constrained , and RAG-Constrained . In the Base setting, the model summarizes directly from the record with minimal control; in the Constrained setting, the same input is generated under explicit clinical communication constraints, implemented as structured instructions within the prompt (for example, factual grounding, uncertainty handling, and nuance-preservation rules, full prompts in Appendix B ). Finally, in the RAG-Constrained setting, those constraints are retained while adding retrieved lay-term definitions to support clearer, simplified explanations (see Appendix C for implementation details). Specifically, the role of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) in this setting is to facilitate text simplification using the README dataset, an extensive collection of over 50,000 unique pairs of medical terms and their lay definitions Yao et al. (2024) .
Together, these constraints enforce evidence-aware summarization over open-ended medical interpretation.
blocks.zh:
我们的系统收集每个病人结构化的月经健康记录(如周期时间、症状、趋势和相关临床背景等领域),并在三代制度下生成病人的成活摘要: 基地, 约束,和RAG - 约束。 在Base设定中,模型直接从记录中总结,控制最小;在Construction的设定中,同样的输入是在明确的临床通信限制下产生的,作为分层指令在即时执行(例如事实地基,不确定性处理,和细微保留规则,附录B中的全部提示.). 最后,在RAG-约束的环境下,保留这些限制,同时增加检索的非定期定义,以支持更明确、更简化的解释(执行细节见附录C)。 具体地说,检索-增强生成(RAG)在这一背景下的作用是利用README数据集促进文本简化,该数据集广泛收集了5万多对独特的医学术语及其平面定义(2024年).
这些制约因素加在一起,迫使人们认识到证据的概括,而不是开放式医疗解释。

blocks.en: Readability, lexical diversity, and jargon. We assess the fidelity-accessibility trade-off along three axes. Grade-level readability : SMOG, FKGL, and ARI, plus Dale-Chall (vocabulary familiarity, largely length-independent); since the three grade-level indices are highly correlated, FKGL is our primary endpoint, with SMOG and ARI as robustness checks. Lexical and syntactic complexity : MTLD (forward-backward averaged, factor threshold 0.72) for lexical variety, and a fixed spaCy parser for mean dependency-tree depth and subordinate-clause ratio, applied identically across conditions; word counts are tracked to detect verbosity inflation. Medical jargon : scispaCy with a UMLS linker identifies terms resolving to a documented UMLS concept, reported as density (entities per 100 words), raw entity count, and entities per sentence.

blocks.en: 4 Results
blocks.zh: 4 结果

blocks.en: We evaluated three models (GPT-4o, Phi-4-mini, and Qwen2.5-14B) across three generation settings ( base , constrained , and rag_constrained ) on 500 structured records, yielding 4,500 generated summaries in total. We report the five semantic-alignment metrics (Table 1 ), together with readability, lexical-diversity, syntactic-complexity, and jargon measures to characterize the fidelity-accessibility trade-off. Because the grade-level readability metrics are strongly intercorrelated, we use FKGL as the primary grade-level endpoint and treat SMOG and ARI as robustness checks; Dale-Chall, MTLD, dependency depth, and subordinate-clause ratio are interpreted as distinct constructs.
blocks.zh: 我们在500个结构化记录上评价了三种模式(GPT-4o、Phi-4-mini和Quen2.5-14B),共产生4 500份摘要。 我们报告五个语义和语义协调度量表(表1),以及可读性、语法多样性、综合性-复杂性,以及描述忠诚-无障碍取舍的术语。 由于分级可读性衡量标准紧密相通,我们使用FKGL作为一级分级终点,并将SMOG和ARI视为稳健性检查;Dale-Chall,MTLD,依赖深度,和从属-clause比例被解释为截然不同的构造.

blocks.en: Across all three models, readability worsens under added control: all three grade-level metrics increase monotonically or near-monotonically from base to constrained to rag_constrained (Table 6 ), with FKGL as the primary endpoint. For GPT-4o, the largest shift occurs between base and constrained (FKGL paired d = 1.39 d=1.39 ; ARI d = 1.22 d=1.22 ; Dale-Chall d = 1.23 d=1.23 ; all p FDR < 10 − 70 p_{\mathrm{FDR}}<10^{-70} ), while the further increase from constrained to rag_constrained is modest for FKGL ( d = 0.26 d=0.26 ) and negligible for ARI ( d = − 0.08 d=-0.08 , n.s. after correction) and Dale-Chall ( d = − 0.09 d=-0.09 , significant but trivial). Dependency-tree depth follows the same pattern: a large increase from base to constrained ( d = 0.90 d=0.90 ) with essentially no further change under retrieval ( d = 0.01 d=0.01 , n.s.). This suggests explicit grounding constraints, rather than retrieval itself, are the main driver of increased reading difficulty. Table 6 shows the same qualitative pattern across models: Phi-4-mini produces the highest grade-level outputs under all settings, GPT-4o occupies the middle range, and Qwen2.5-14B is typically lowest on FKGL and ARI once constraints are applied.

Phi-4-mini declines similarly, from a much higher starting point. Qwen2.5-14B is comparatively stable, even rising slightly from base to constrained before returning near baseline under retrieval. The lexical-diversity cost of constrained generation is therefore model-dependent rather than universal.

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en: 5.1 Readability
blocks.zh: 5.1 可读性

blocks.en:
Taken together, these results indicate that the evidence-grounding
mechanisms evaluated for their effect on factual alignment in
Section 3 carry a measurable cost in accessibility.
Grade-level readability increases substantially once explicit
constraints are applied, largely independent of whether retrieval is
also used, while lexical diversity decreases and domain-term mentions
increase in absolute terms even as their density per word declines.
This is consistent with the readability-fidelity tension noted in
constrained clinical summarization more broadly Verma et al. (2026) ,
and suggests that the drift-reduction constraints introduced in this
work should be evaluated jointly against both factual alignment and
reading difficulty rather than either in isolation. We treat this joint
analysis, correlating the per-sample drift metrics of
Table 1 against the per-sample readability
measures reported here, as a direct extension of the present results.
One caveat applies to how we measure readability: FKGL, ARI, and SMOG are based on sentence length and syllable counts, not on how conceptually difficult a word actually is. This means a technical term like "ptosis" can score as easier than an everyday word like "congratulations" simply because it has fewer syllables. This matters for our RAG results as FKGL increases modestly from Constrained to RAG-Constrained (d=0.26) despite stable sentence length, driven mainly by near-doubled medical-term counts. This suggests the extra difficulty these formulas detect comes mainly from added vocabulary, not from harder sentence structure, especially since RAG also supplies a lay definition alongside each term. This doesn’t remove the broader readability cost we report above, but it suggests the part of that cost caused specifically by RAG may be smaller than the raw grade-level scores suggest.

blocks.en: Diagnostic overreach is almost entirely a vocabulary artifact. Its apparent rise under RAG is fully explained by terms like "pregnancy" and "ectopic pregnancy." Pregnancy is a physiological state and not a true pathology that legitimately surfaces when explaining fertility, which RAG actively supplies. Removing these terms drops overreach to ≤ \leq 0.6 percent for every model and condition, proving that the models almost never suggest genuinely unsupported pathologies. We recommend reporting these corrected figures as the primary result and separating reproductive contexts from the pathological diagnostic vocabulary.

blocks.en: Omission drift is model-dependent: GPT-4o benefits from the full pipeline, Qwen2.5-14B from constraints alone, and Phi-4-mini uniquely worsens with more grounding. Phi-4-mini’s regression aligns with its readability profile; it adds discursive, explanatory prose rather than restating specific field values outright (e.g., "Resting HR: 71.3"). Because the omission metric checks for direct statements of salient fields, Phi-4-mini fails the strict entailment check even when the underlying information is not truly lost. This indicates the metric is sensitive to surface realization and stylistic differences.
blocks.zh: 漏出漂移依赖模型:GPT-4o从全管中得益;Quen2.5-14B单从受限得到好处;而Phi-4-mini则随着地基的增大而特别恶化. Phi-4-mini的回归与它的可读性特征一致;它添加了曲折的,解释性的通用语,而不是直接重述特定的字段值(例如"Resting HR:71.3"). 由于对显著字段的直接声明的省略度量检查,Phi-4-mini即使基本信息没有真正丢失,也未能进行严格的必然检查。 这表明该度量衡对地表实现和结构差异敏感.

blocks.en: These results complicate a simple "more grounding is better" narrative. Explicit constraints alone account for most metric improvements. Retrieval’s marginal contribution is genuinely positive for epistemic calibration and, once corrected, largely positive or neutral for faithfulness but its effect on omission remains mixed, and its apparent cost for diagnostic overreach is a vocabulary artifact rather than a real effect.
blocks.zh: 这些结果使一个简单的"更打地是更好的"叙事复杂化. 仅是明确的制约因素就说明了大部分的改进。 检索的边际贡献对于感官校正来说是真正积极的,而且一旦纠正,对于忠诚性来说基本上是积极的或中立的,但是它对遗漏的影响仍然是好坏参半的,其诊断过度的明显代价是词汇的产物,而不是真正的效果。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
We find that evidence-grounded constrained generation improves clinical alignment along
specific dimensions. The clearest and most consistent effect across all three models is
reduced epistemic misalignment. Retrieval further improves faithfulness for GPT-4o and is
faithfulness-neutral for the other two models, while its effects on omission and urgency
remain smaller and model-dependent. At the same time, constrained and RAG-constrained
outputs become harder to read, often less lexically diverse, and heavier in medical
terminology.

blocks.en:
These results suggest that safer health summarization is not a single-metric problem. Systems must be evaluated jointly for faithfulness, uncertainty preservation, coverage, and readability.
This work provides practical guidance to tackle this challenge.
More broadly, it contributes a structured-to-narrative evaluation setting and a semantic alignment framework for studying how LLMs turn physiological data into patient-readable explanations.
blocks.zh:
这些结果表明,安全的健康汇总不是一个单一衡量问题。 必须共同评价各种系统是否忠实、是否保持不确定性、是否涵盖范围以及是否可读。
这项工作为应对这一挑战提供了实际指导。
更广泛地说,它为研究LLMS如何将生理数据转化为患者可读的解释提供了结构化到叙述式评价的设置和语义相协调的框架。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Our study has several limitations that should inform how these results are interpreted.
blocks.zh: 我们的研究有一些局限性,应当用来解释这些结果。

blocks.en: All five clinical alignment metrics rely on automatic tools: an NLI model (PubMedBERT-MNLI-MedNLI) for faithfulness violation and omission drift, a named entity recognizer with negation handling for diagnostic inference overreach, and a single LLM judge for urgency misalignment. While these are established approaches in the factuality literature, prior work has documented that clinical NLI models contain annotation artifacts and degrade under domain shift, and that textual entailment does not always correspond to factual support. We do not have a human-annotated subsample to validate any of the five metrics against clinician or expert judgment, and we treat this as the most important direction for follow-up work.
blocks.zh: 所有五个临床校正度量度都依赖于自动工具:一个用于忠心违抗和疏漏漂移的NLI模型(PubMedBERT-MNLI-MedNLI),一个被命名为实体识别器,负责诊断推论过量的否定处理,以及一个负责紧急错位的LLM法官. 虽然这些是事实文献中既定的方法,但以前的工作表明,临床NLI模型含有注释文物,在域移下会降解,而文字含义并不总是符合事实支持。 我们没有经过人说明的子样本来验证五个衡量标准中任何一种与临床医生或专家判断相反,我们将此视为后续工作的最重要方向。

blocks.en: Urgency misalignment is scored by a single model (Claude 3.5 Haiku) at a fixed temperature, without inter-rater reliability checks, comparison to human raters, or an ensemble of judges. Given that this metric concerns tone rather than propositional content, it is more subjective than the other four and may be more sensitive to idiosyncrasies of the judge model.
blocks.zh: 紧急错位被一个模型(Claude 3.5 Haiku)在固定温度下打出分数,不进行评分之间可靠性检查,与人评分比较,或评分组合. 鉴于这一衡量标准涉及的是语气而不是命题内容,因此它比其他四个更主观,可能对法官模式的特有性更为敏感.

blocks.en: Our dataset is generated from a causal DAG that encodes documented physiological relationships between cycle phase, sleep, and autonomic measures, and includes internal coherence checks (Appendix A ). The DAG structure and its parameters are our own modeling choices, and neither the generated records nor the associated ground truth have been reviewed by a clinician for biological realism. We note that this limitation is partially mitigated by the nature of our evaluation: our alignment metrics measure whether a generated summary Y Y is semantically faithful to its own source record X X , not whether X X itself is a biologically accurate depiction of the menstrual cycle. In this sense the task is closer to a semantic consistency analysis than a biological validity analysis, and the alignment scores we report do not depend on the DAG being an accurate model of physiology. Clinician review of the DAG would therefore primarily affect the realism of the input distribution rather than the validity of the alignment measurements themselves. That said, this gap still matters for generalization as real-world self-tracked data is likely to be noisier, more idiosyncratic, and structured differently than data produced by a hand-specified generative model, and our results should be understood as characterizing model behavior on this particular semi-synthetic input distribution rather than on real user data.
blocks.zh: 我们的数据集来自一个因果DAG,它编码了循环相、睡眠和自体测量之间的记录的生理关系,并包括内部一致性检查(附录A.)。 DAG结构及其参数是我们自己的建模选择,生成的记录和相关的地层真理都没有被临床医生为了生物现实主义而审查. 我们注意到,这一限制因我们评价的性质而部分地得到缓解:我们的校正度量度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度 从这个意义上讲,任务比生物有效性分析更接近语义一致性分析,我们报告的对齐分数并不依赖于DAG是生理学的准确模型. 因此,临床医生对DAG的审查将主要影响输入分配的现实性,而不是调整测量本身的有效性。 尽管如此,这个差距仍然需要泛泛而论,因为现实世界的自跟踪数据很可能是无名的,更具有特异性,结构上不同于由手定基因模型生成的数据,我们的结果应该被理解为是描述这个特定的半合成输入分布的模型行为,而不是真实的用户数据.

blocks.en: In our RAG-Constrained setting, retrieval is limited to lay-term definitions drawn from the README dataset and is not used to supply additional clinical evidence beyond the structured record. Our findings about the marginal contribution of retrieval should therefore be understood as specific to this specific use of RAG, and may not generalize to settings where retrieval is used to bring in additional clinical context.
blocks.zh: 在我们的RAG-约束设置中,检索仅限于从README数据集中提取的定期定义,不用于提供结构化记录之外的额外临床证据. 因此,我们关于检索的边际贡献的调查结果应被理解为是这种RAG的具体用途所特有的,可能不会被概括到利用检索带来更多临床环境的场合.

blocks.en: As discussed in the main text, we are not aware of prior systems that perform structured-to-narrative generation in this domain, so we rely on internal ablations (Base, Constrained, RAG-Constrained) rather than comparison to an external baseline. This limits our ability to situate the absolute performance of our pipeline relative to other possible approaches.
blocks.zh: 如正文所讨论,我们不知道以前有系统化到描述性生成的系统,因此我们依靠内部活化(Base, Constract, RAG- Constract)而不是比较外部基线. 这限制了我们相对于其他可能的办法,确定我们管道的绝对性能的能力。

blocks.en: Our experiments focus exclusively on menstrual health monitoring using a semi-synthetic dataset. We do not evaluate other physiological domains, and the generative model does not represent the full diversity of menstrual cycle presentations, medical conditions, or demographic variation present in real populations. Findings may not transfer directly to other health domains or to more clinically atypical records.
blocks.zh: 我们的实验完全集中于使用半合成数据集进行月经健康监测. 我们不评估其他生理领域,基因模型并不代表月经周期的完全多样性、医疗条件或实际人群中的人口变化。 调查结果可能不会直接转移到其他保健领域,也不会转移到临床上更非典型的记录。

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en: All experiments in this paper use a semi-synthetic dataset generated from a causal statistical model (Appendix A ). No real patient records, wearable device data, or personally identifiable health information were collected, accessed, or used at any stage of this work. This eliminates direct privacy risk from our experiments, though it also means our findings should not be taken as validated on real-world data distributions.
blocks.zh: 本文中的所有实验都使用由因果统计模型产生的半合成数据集(Appendix A. 在这项工作的任何阶段,都没有收集、获取或使用真正的病人记录、可穿戴设备数据或个人可识别的健康信息。 这消除了我们实验中直接的隐私风险,虽然这也意味着我们的研究结果不应被当做是真实世界数据分布的验证.

blocks.en: This work studies failure modes, including faithfulness violation, epistemic misalignment, diagnostic inference overreach, omission drift, and urgency misalignment, in LLM-generated health summaries. Our intent is diagnostic and evaluative: to make these failure modes measurable so that they can be mitigated, not to present any of the three tested generation configurations as ready for deployment in a real patient-facing product. None of the metrics or pipelines described here have been clinically validated, and none should be used, as-is, to make or support real health or diagnostic decisions. In particular, our diagnostic inference overreach metric is intended to detect unsupported pathology mentions for research purposes; it is not a clinical safety filter and should not be relied on as one.
blocks.zh: 这项工作在LLM生成的健康摘要中研究了失败模式,包括忠贞违纪、癫痫错位、诊断性推论过量、疏漏漂移和紧急错位等。 我们的用意是诊断和评价:使这些故障模式可以衡量,以便它们能够被减轻,而不是提出三种经过测试的生成配置中的任何一种,以备用于真正的病人培养产品。 本文所述的衡量标准或管道均未经过临床验证,任何标准或管道均不应用于作出或支持真正的健康或诊断决定。 特别是,我们的诊断推论超前测量标准旨在检测用于研究目的的无根据病理学参考;它不是一个临床安全过滤器,不应作为一个系统依赖。

blocks.en: Menstrual health monitoring involves personal and sometimes stigmatized health information. We chose this domain because cyclical signals, intrinsic physiological uncertainty, and the documented consequences of urgency miscalibration make it a particularly informative and consequential setting for studying evidence-grounded generation, not because we treat it as a low-stakes proxy for health tasks more broadly. We encourage readers to interpret our results as evidence for the general difficulty of structured-to-narrative health summarization, rather than as specific claims about menstrual health applications being closer to solved than other clinical domains.
blocks.zh: 月经健康监测涉及个人健康信息,有时还带有污名。 我们选择这个领域是因为周期性信号,内在的生理不确定性,以及记录到的紧迫性误判的后果,使得它成为研究有证据依据的生成的一个特别信息化和结果性的环境,而不是因为我们把它作为更广义的卫生任务低摄取的代名词. 我们鼓励读者将我们的结果解释为结构化到叙述性健康总结的一般困难的证据,而不是关于月经健康应用比其他临床领域更接近解决的具体说法.

blocks.en: Several of our metrics rely on automatic NLI models, named entity recognition, and an LLM-as-judge (for urgency misalignment). These are research instruments for comparing generation configurations at scale and have known limitations, including domain shift sensitivity and lack of validated correspondence to clinician judgment (see Limitations). They should not be interpreted as clinically validated safety metrics, and results derived from them should not be used to certify any system as safe for patient-facing use.
blocks.zh: 我们的几个衡量标准依赖于自动NLI模型、命名实体识别和一个LLM即时裁判(紧急错位)。 这些是用于在规模上比较生成配置的研究工具,并有已知的局限性,包括域位移敏感性和与临床医生判断缺乏经过验证的对应(见局限性). 它们不应被解释为经临床验证的安全衡量标准,因此所产生的结果不应用于证明任何系统对病人的安全使用。

blocks.en: We release our dataset generation code (Appendix A ) to support reproducibility and further research into evidence-grounded health summarization. We do not release, and did not train, any model intended for deployment. We encourage future work building on this framework to include clinician review and human evaluation of generated summaries before considering any real-world patient-facing application.
blocks.zh: 我们发布了我们的数据集生成代码(Appendix A),以支持可复制性,并进一步研究循证健康总结. 我们没有释放也没有训练任何打算部署的型号。 我们鼓励今后在这一框架的基础上开展工作,包括临床医生对生成的摘要进行审查和人力评估,然后再考虑任何符合现实世界的病人申请。

blocks.en:
This appendix specifies the retrieval component used in the
RAG-Constrained setting.
Retrieval plays a deliberately narrow role: it supplies lay-term
definitions that support simplification, rather than injecting new
clinical evidence. All grounding definitions are drawn from the
README dataset ( Yao et al., 2024 ) , represented as (medical term, lay definition) pairs, where the term field is
indexed for retrieval and the definition field is returned as
grounding context. Prior to indexing, we drop rows with a missing
term or definition and remove exact duplicate pairs after case- and
whitespace-normalization, so that a single definition cannot occupy
multiple retrieval slots; only the deduplicated, non-null rows are
indexed.

blocks.en:
We use a sparse TF–IDF retriever with cosine similarity. At this corpus size, TF–IDF is
fully local (requiring no model download or additional network
dependency), fast to build and query, and provides a transparent,
inspectable matching signal, while leaving a clear upgrade path to
dense retrieval without changing the surrounding pipeline. The term
index is built with an sklearn TfidfVectorizer using
English stop-word removal and an n n -gram range of ( 1 , 2 ) (1,2) ; combining
unigram and bigram features allows multi-word terms such as “menstrual cramps” to match on shared unigrams while still
retaining some phrase-level signal. For a given query q q , we compute
cosine similarity against all indexed terms, rank candidates in
descending order, and return at most k = 3 k=3 definitions, retaining only
matches with similarity at least 0.12 0.12 . This similarity floor treats
weak lexical overlap as “no match” rather than forcing spurious
grounding, and any duplicate definitions surviving to the ranking
stage are skipped so that the injected context contains distinct
entries.
The concatenated text forms the retrieval query, and the top- k k retrieved definitions
are formatted as a bulleted Retrieved Context block and
inserted into the RAG-Constrained prompt (Appendix B ).
